caption: The image is a drawing of a human figure, standing upright and facing forward, located centrally on a plain, light beige background. The figure has medium brown skin, black hair styled simply, and visible facial features including eyes, nose, and red lips. The figure is dressed in a fitted white garment that resembles a historical undergarment or bodysuit, with light green bands at the upper arms and above the knees. The garment appears to be sewn with visible seam lines and buttons down the center. The hands and feet are visible, with the lower legs and feet covered by the same white fabric as the rest of the bodysuit. There are no additional objects or details in the background, and the overall composition is symmetrical and uncluttered. The artist's signature, "Rex Bush," is located in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Doll - "Drucilla"
